newsitem.title: UK: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MOSTLY DIP BUT MOGAS GAINS $3.
newsitem.headline: NWE OIL PRODUCTS MOSTLY DIP BUT MOGAS GAINS $3.

text.p: NWE oil products were mostly weaker on Wednesday apart from gasoline which extended recent gains.
High sulphur fuel oil barges eased by some $1 after buyers bit by higher prices suddenly disappeared from the market late in the day while cargoes were still talked steady around $92.50.
Mogas barge values gained $3 to around $238 after earlier $5 gains were partially rolled back on the Nymex declines.
Gas oil cargoes were little changed but Rotterdam barges eased slightly on poor demand.
